queries.description: Frozen query config including bank,N,r,M,m,mode hash,contract,scheme,dt,input/output shape and Q1/Q2 scope. Operator interventions are separate from end-to-end native queries.

case_results.description: query id -> case id -> exact timed invocation linkage, actual returned-field restricted E0 score, native/common production-tight distances with declared norms, work, coefficients/all states/raw hashes and masks.

operator_differences.description: Frozen A65/A129,lambda65/lambda129 and P scaling files/hashes plus explicitly labeled diffusion-only/moment-only/composite interventions; no silent production-equation changes.

projection_budgets.description: Common65 E0 oracle coefficients/residuals, orthogonality and Pythagorean checks; native129 Gram never substitutes for the scoring metric.

execution.description: Exact source/config/job/GPU, complete raw manifest and diagnostics-only qualification scope. Peak memory is labeled cumulative whole-job; setup current-memory deltas separate.
